sources.snippet: Lightning Pose is an end-to-end package designed for robust multi-view and single-view animal pose estimation using advanced transformer architectures. It leverages Multi-View Transformers and simulated occlusions to learn geometric relationships between views, resulting in strong performance on occlusions (Aharon, Whiteway et al., 2026).
